headline: Code-execution flaw found in widely used UEFI firmware
summary: A critical flaw in UEFI firmware, used by most server vendors and data centers, allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process. Both outlets describe the flaw as affecting most servers on the planet.

claims.statement: A critical flaw in UEFI firmware allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process.
